content.text:
## Investigation: `combat_test.tscn` overwrite/strip mechanisms

**Current on-disk state (May 22):** `C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/combat_test.tscn` is **stripped again** — ~268 lines, only `BlackBackground`, overlays, and legacy hidden nodes. **Missing:** `%CombatRoot`, `%MetaBox`, `%SeedSpinBox`, `%BankrollLabel`, `%GoalBox`, `%StakeSelector`, `%SpinButton`, `%MultiplierReadout`. That matches the “black + scanlines only” failure mode.

Git status also shows both `M AXEL/axel_project/combat/combat_test.tscn` and `?? AXEL\axel_project\combat\combat_test.tscn` (same file, mixed path separators) — a OneDrive/Windows sync red flag.

---

## (1) Concrete overwrite mechanisms found

| Rank | Mechanism | Path(s) | How it could rewrite/strip |
|------|-----------|---------|------------------------------|
| **1** | **Godot `@tool` editor preview + scene save** | `C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/combat_test.gd` | `@tool` runs layout at editor open; dynamically builds/reparents nodes; some get `set_owner(null)`, others don’t. Saving the scene (Ctrl+S, close project, autosave) can persist a reduced tree. `_cache_scene_refs()` aborts if scaffold nodes are gone → blank UI. |
| **2** | **OneDrive sync / stale cloud copy on reboot** | Workspace root `C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/` | Reboot regression documented in [combat editor parity transcript](75c1222b-95c4-4ed4-9978-9ea1f5facf23). Dual git path entries suggest sync/path confusion. |
| **3** | **Cursor agent direct `.tscn` edits + git restore cycles** | Agent transcripts under `C:/Users/valtt/.cursor/projects/c-Users-valtt-OneDrive-Godot/agent-transcripts/` | Multiple agents edited `combat_test.tscn` (layout parity, cascade pill, v1/v2 cleanup). Restores used `git checkout --` / `git checkout bab7ec5 --` when stripped — fixes are uncommitted and can revert. |
| **4** | **Duplicate cleanup agent (indirect / same-day confusion)** | Transcript `4d189df3-590e-452c-b1e7-369800cbf07a` | Deleted `combat/art/placeholders/` and updated symbol `.tres` only. **Did not touch `combat_test.tscn`.** Blamed in later debug session, but not a direct file writer. |
| **5** | **Scene builder pipeline** | `C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/tools/scene_builder/*` | Writes JSON only (`scene_patch_instructions.json`). Targets `scenes/Arc_*/*.tscn`, not combat. Explicitly “does not modify scenes directly.” |
| **—** | **Not found** | `.git/hooks/*`, VS Code tasks, QA scripts | No git hooks; tasks only open Affinity; `scene_smoke_check.gd` loads scenes but **does not write** them; `update_qa_analytics.py` writes markdown only. |

---

## (2) Strongest likely culprit (ranked)

### #1 — Godot `@tool` editor save cycle (primary)

The May 19 editor-parity work made `combat_test.gd` a `@tool` script with `editor_preview_enabled: true` default. The script **requires** scene-file nodes but also **mutates the tree at editor time** (`_build_play_shell`, `_reparent_hud_to_root`, `combat.reparent(_grid_host)`, etc.).

When those required nodes disappear from the `.tscn`, init exits early:

```373:419:C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/combat_test.gd
func _cache_scene_refs() -> bool:
	// ...
	if combat == null or not is_instance_valid(combat):
		combat = get_node_or_null("%CombatRoot") as CombatRootScript
	// ...
	var ok := spin_btn != null and bankroll_label != null and meta_box != null
```

```471:479:C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/combat_test.gd
func _initialize_runtime() -> void:
	// ...
	if not _cache_scene_refs():
		_agent_debug_log(..., "cache_scene_refs_failed", ...)
		return
```

**Why it repeats:** stripped file → blank play → restore from git → works → save/sync/reopen → stripped again.

### #2 — OneDrive sync on reboot (amplifier)

Same failure after PC restart; git showed clean HEAD with missing nodes at one point (stripped version may be what git tracks if never committed good). Workspace living in OneDrive increases “worked yesterday, broken today” risk.

### #3 — Cursor agent `.tscn` edits (contributor, not a dedicated cleanup script)

Historical agents rewrote the scene for layout/HUD work. No repo script automates this, but agents can strip node blocks via Godot save or direct patch.

**Duplicate cleanup is unlikely as direct cause** — it only removed PNG placeholders under `combat/art/placeholders/`.

---

## (3) Evidence snippets

**Changelog documents `@tool` + scene edit + later restore:**
> “Converted `combat_test.gd` to `@tool` … `set_owner(null)` on editor-only dynamic nodes … Set `CombatRoot` visible by default in `combat_test.tscn`.”  
> — `C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/plans/core/AI_CHANGELOG.md` (2026-05-19 Editor/Runtime Layout Parity)

> “Reverted `combat_test.tscn` … restoring required nodes (`CombatRoot`, `MetaBox`, `SeedSpinBox`, …)”  
> — same changelog (2026-05-19 Scene Scaffold Restore)

**Agent transcript — git diff showed mass node removal:**
> “`git diff` shows those nodes were removed from `AXEL/axel_project/combat/combat_test.tscn`”  
> — [75c1222b…](75c1222b-95c4-4ed4-9978-9ea1f5facf23)

**Runtime debug proof of stripped scaffold:**
> `combat_root_node_exists:false`, `spin_btn:false`, `meta_box:false`, `ok:false` → `cache_scene_refs_failed`  
> — same transcript, `debug-75c122.log` analysis

**Duplicate cleanup scope (NOT combat scene):**
> “Deleted: `AXEL/axel_project/combat/art/placeholders/**`”  
> — changelog 2026-05-19 Combat Symbol Art Dedup

**Scene builder non-writer contract:**
> “This file is a patch interface contract and does not modify scenes directly.”  
> — `C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/tools/scene_builder/scene_patch_interface.py`

**AI docs — scene agent cleanup is output-only, narrative scenes:**
> “`scene agent` MUST clean up … under `tools/scene_builder/output/`”  
> — `C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/plans/core/AI_DOCS.md` §11

**Current file lacks scaffold** — grep finds `CombatRoot` only in `combat/scenes/combat_root.tscn`, not in `combat/combat_test.tscn`.

---

## (4) Recommended guardrails (repo-specific)

1. **Commit a known-good `combat_test.tscn` from commit `bab7ec5` (or post-restore version)**  
   Restores today are local-only; without commit, git/OneDrive can keep serving the stripped copy.

2. **Add headless scaffold validator** (extend `C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/test/scene_smoke_check.gd` or new `combat/test/combat_test_scaffold_check.gd`)  
   Assert these exist in the `.tscn` text or after instantiate: `%CombatRoot`, `%MetaBox`, `%SeedSpinBox`, `%BankrollLabel`, `%GoalBox`, `%StakeSelector`, `%SpinButton`, `%MultiplierReadout`. Fail fast with explicit missing-node list.

3. **Pre-commit hook (optional but high value)**  
   Run scaffold check on `AXEL/axel_project/combat/combat_test.tscn` only. Block commits that remove required node names.

4. **Document in `AI_DOCS.md` / agent rules:**  
   - `combat/combat_test.tscn` is **protected canonical scaffold** — agents must not bulk-delete nodes or “simplify” the scene.  
   - Duplicate/cleanup tasks: **never** edit `combat/*.tscn` unless explicitly requested.  
   - Prefer script-only layout changes in `combat_test.gd`.

5. **Godot editor discipline**  
   - Set `editor_preview_enabled = false` before saving the scene, or avoid saving `combat_test.tscn` while preview is rebuilding.  
   - After any agent restore: **Project → Reload Current Project** so Godot doesn’t keep stale in-memory tree.

6. **OneDrive mitigation**  
   - Pause OneDrive sync during Godot sessions, or move repo out of OneDrive.  
   - Watch for duplicate path entries in `git status`.

7. **Wire scaffold check into existing QA path**  
   Run before `scene_smoke_check.gd` in the rubric’s headless command set (`tools/cmd/godot.cmd --headless --path AXEL/axel_project -s res://test/...`).

---

**Bottom line:** There is **no repo automation script** that bulk-rewrites `combat_test.tscn`. The recurring strip pattern is **scene-file scaffold loss** (required nodes deleted from `.tscn`), most plausibly from **Godot `@tool` editor saves** and **OneDrive/git state drift**, with **Cursor agent scene edits** as a secondary contributor. The duplicate PNG cleanup did not directly target this file but happened in the same debugging window.
